entry.content:
English Version

Title

Calculation of Parallel Capacitor Size and Power Factor Improvement

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive required capacitor reactive power for PF correction and convert it to capacitance.
  • Why it matters: Proper capacitor sizing reduces current, losses, and penalties while improving voltage regulation.
  • What you’ll learn: Use PF angles to compute $Q_C$ and convert to $C$ via frequency and voltage.

Key Points

  • PF improvement by adding a shunt capacitor across an inductive load.
  • Reactive power:
    • Before: $ Q_L = P\tan\theta_1 $
    • After: $ Q_T = P\tan\theta_2 $
    • Capacitor: $ Q_C = Q_L - Q_T = P(\tan\theta_1 - \tan\theta_2) $
  • Capacitance sizing:

$$C = \frac{Q_C}{2\pi f V^2}$$
where $f$ is frequency, $V$ is voltage (RMS), $Q_C$ is capacitor reactive power.

Reference

  • YouTube: Auto-translated video

並聯電容器大小計算與功率因數改善

  • 主題範圍：由功率因數角推得所需電容虛功並換算電容量。
  • 為何重要：適當的電容補償可降低電流與線損、改善電壓調節並避免低 PF 罰款。
  • 你將學到：利用 PF 角計算 $Q_C$，並以頻率與電壓換算為 $C$。

重點統整

  • 改善 PF 方法：在電感性負載兩端並聯電容器。
  • 虛功計算：
    • 改善前 $ Q_L = P\tan\theta_1 $
    • 改善後 $ Q_T = P\tan\theta_2 $
    • 電容 $ Q_C = Q_L - Q_T = P(\tan\theta_1 - \tan\theta_2) $
  • 電容量公式：
    $$C = \frac{Q_C}{2\pi f V^2}$$

，並以頻率與電壓換算為

其中 $f$ 為頻率、$V$ 為電壓（有效值）、$Q_C$ 為電容虛功。

entry.title: 視在功率範例解析（Part B）
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Apparent Power Examples (Part B)

Introduction

  • Scope: Walk through three typical scenarios of apparent power S in AC circuits: phasor product, complex impedance, and transformer ratings.
  • Why it matters: Apparent power bridges voltage and current magnitudes regardless of phase, underpinning sizing of equipment and conductors.
  • What you’ll learn: How to compute S, separate it into P and Q when impedance is known, and apply kVA ratings to estimate allowable currents.

Key Points

  1. Example 1: Apparent Power in Single-Phase AC Circuit

    • Voltage $ V = 10 \angle 60^\circ $ V
    • Current $ I = 10 \angle 15^\circ $ A
    • Apparent power $ S = V \times I = 100 $ VA

  2. Example 2: Power Calculation with Complex Impedance

    • Impedance $ Z = 8 + j6 $ Ω (8 Ω resistor in series with inductive reactance 6 Ω)
    • Current $ I = 10 $ A
    • Real power $ P = I^2 R = 800 $ W
    • Reactive power $ Q = I^2 X_L = 600 $ VAR
    • Apparent power $ S = I^2 |Z| = 1000 $ VA

  3. Example 3: Transformer Maximum Input and Output Current

    • Rated apparent power $ S = 10,\text{kVA} $
    • Input voltage $ V_{in} = 2000,\text{V} $, output voltage $ V_{out} = 200,\text{V} $
    • Maximum input current $ I_{in} = \frac{S}{V_{in}} = 5,\text{A} $
    • Maximum output current $ I_{out} = \frac{S}{V_{out}} = 50,\text{A} $

Reference

  • YouTube: High school basic electricity – AC power – Apparent Power PART B (Examples)

中文版

標題

視在功率範例解析（Part B）

前言

  • 主題範圍：透過三個常見情境認識視在功率 S 的計算：相量相乘、複數阻抗分解、變壓器容量應用。
  • 為何重要：視在功率連結電壓與電流的大小（不論相位），是設備與線路容量選用的依據。
  • 你將學到：如何計算 S、在已知阻抗時拆解為 P 與 Q，以及運用 kVA 額定值估算允許電流。

重點統整

  1. 範例一：單相交流電路視在功率

    • 電壓 $ V = 10 \angle 60^\circ $ 伏特
    • 電流 $ I = 10 \angle 15^\circ $ 安培
    • 視在功率 $ S = V \times I = 100 $ 伏安

  2. 範例二：複數阻抗的功率計算

    • 阻抗 $ Z = 8 + j6 $ 歐姆（8 歐姆電阻串聯 6 歐姆感抗）
    • 電流 $ I = 10 $ 安培
    • 平均功率 $ P = I^2 R = 800 $ 瓦特
    • 無功功率 $ Q = I^2 X_L = 600 $ 乏爾（VAR）
    • 視在功率 $ S = I^2 |Z| = 1000 $ 伏安

  3. 範例三：變壓器最大輸入／輸出電流

    • 額定視在功率 $ S = 10,\text{kVA} $
    • 輸入電壓 $ V_{in} = 2000,\text{V} $，輸出電壓 $ V_{out} = 200,\text{V} $
    • 最大輸入電流 $ I_{in} = \frac{S}{V_{in}} = 5,\text{A} $
    • 最大輸出電流 $ I_{out} = \frac{S}{V_{out}} = 50,\text{A} $

entry.title: 串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係 / Relationship Between PF of Series and Parallel Circuits
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Relationship Between Power Factor (PF) of Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Show closed-form PF formulas for RL series and parallel and their relation.
  • Why it matters: Lets you translate PF between topologies instantly when $R$ and $X_L$ match.
  • What you’ll learn: Series PF, parallel PF, and identity $PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$.

Key Points

  • Series PF $PFS$:

$$PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • Parallel PF $PFP$:

$$PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • If $R$ and $X_L$ are identical in both circuits:

$$PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$$

  • Example: $R=4,\Omega, X_L=3,\Omega$ → $PFS=0.8$, $PFP=0.6$

Reference

  • YouTube: PF – Series vs Parallel Relationship

中文版

標題

串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係

前言

  • 主題範圍：列出 RL 串聯與並聯電路的 PF 閉式公式，並說明相互關係。
  • 為何重要：當 $R$、$X_L$ 相同時，可在兩拓撲間快速換算 PF。
  • 你將學到：串聯 PF、並聯 PF 與恆等式 $PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$。

重點統整

  • 串聯功率因數：

$$PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • 並聯功率因數：

$$PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • 當兩電路 $R$、$X_L$ 相同：

$$PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$$

  • 範例：$R=4,\Omega, X_L=3,\Omega$ → $PFS=0.8$、$PFP=0.6$

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_題型二：PT/QT/ST 與 PF 的計算步驟_PART A（延伸）
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering – AC Power – Problem Type 2: Steps for PT/QT/ST and PF (PART A, Extended)

Introduction

  • Scope: Solve a representative circuit (type 2) by computing branch currents, then PT, QT, ST, and PF.
  • Why it matters: A structured flow avoids mixing P and Q contributions and clarifies lagging vs. leading PF.
  • What you’ll learn: How to apply current division, sum active/reactive power, and derive overall apparent power and PF.

Key Points Summary

  1. Example Problem Introduction
    • Circuit type 2 for PT, QT, ST, and PF
    • Tasks: compute powers and power factor
  2. Calculation of Branch Currents
    • Use current division to obtain RMS currents $ I_1, I_2, I_3 $
    • $ I_1, I_2 $ via impedance division; $ I_3 $ equals total current
  3. Total Active Power $P_T$
    • Resistor power: $ P = I^2 R $
    • Sum power on 5 Ω and 1 Ω resistors
  4. Total Reactive Power $Q_T$
    • Reactors/capacitor: $ Q = I^2 X $
    • Sum inductive Q and subtract capacitive Q
  5. Total Apparent Power $S_T$
    • $ S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} $
  6. Power Factor $PF$
    • $ PF = \frac{P_T}{S_T} $, indicate lagging (inductive) or leading (capacitive)

Reference

  • YouTube: AC Power – Problem Type 2: PT/QT/ST and PF

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_題型二：PT/QT/ST 與 PF 的計算步驟_PART A（延伸）

前言

  • 主題範圍：針對題型二，先由各支路電流著手，依序求 PT、QT、ST 與 PF。
  • 為何重要：流程化可避免 P、Q 來源混淆，並正確判定滯後/超前功率因數。
  • 你將學到：分流定則應用、P/Q 加總、視在功率與功率因數的整體推導。

重點統整

  1. 範例題目介紹
    • 介紹 PT、QT、ST 與 PF 的電路圖題型二
    • 求各項功率與功率因數
  2. 各支路電流計算
    • 使用分流定則計算 $ I_1, I_2, I_3 $（有效值）
    • $ I_1, I_2 $ 由阻抗分流；$ I_3 $ 與總電流相同
  3. 總平均功率 $P_T$ 計算
    • 電阻功率：$ P = I^2 R $
    • 計算 5 Ω 與 1 Ω 電阻功率並相加
  4. 總虛功率 $Q_T$ 計算
    • 電感/電容的虛功率：$ Q = I^2 X $
    • 電感虛功率相加後減去電容虛功率
  5. 總視在功率 $S_T$ 計算
    • $ S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} $
  6. 功率因數 $PF$ 計算
    • $ PF = \frac{P_T}{S_T} $，結果標註滯後（電感性）或超前（電容性）

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Relationship Between Power Factor (PF) of Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive and compare power factor definitions for series RL and parallel RL circuits with the same R and XL.
  • Why it matters: Understanding PF relationships helps convert results between topologies and quickly estimate PF without re-deriving.
  • What you’ll learn: Closed-form PF formulas, the identity $PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$, and a numerical example.

Key Points

  • Power Factor of Series Circuit (PFS):

$$PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • Power Factor of Parallel Circuit (PFP):

$$PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • If $R$ and $X_L$ are the same in both circuits:

$$PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$$

  • Example:
    • $R = 4,\Omega, ; X_L = 3,\Omega$
    • Series PF $PFS = 0.8$
    • Parallel PF $PFP = 0.6$

Reference

  • YouTube: High school basic electricity – AC power – Power Factor PART G: Relationship of Series PF and Parallel PF

中文版

標題

串聯電路功率因數 (PF) 與並聯電路功率因數的關係

前言

  • 主題範圍：推導並比較在相同 $R$ 與 $X_L$ 下，串聯 RL 與並聯 RL 電路的功率因數。
  • 為何重要：理解兩種拓撲之 PF 關係，可在兩者之間快速換算並估算 PF，無需每次重推。
  • 你將學到：PF 的閉式公式、恆等式 $PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$ 與數值範例。

重點統整

  • 串聯電路功率因數 (PFS)：

$$PFS = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • 並聯電路功率因數 (PFP)：

$$PFP = \frac{X_L}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}$$

  • 若兩電路的 $R$ 與 $X_L$ 相同，則：

$$PFS^2 + PFP^2 = 1$$

  • 範例：
    • $R = 4,\Omega, ; X_L = 3,\Omega$
    • 串聯功率因數 $PFS = 0.8$
    • 並聯功率因數 $PFP = 0.6$

entry.title: 使用阻抗觀念求功率因數（PF）— R-L 串聯與並聯電路 / Calculating PF Using Impedance — R-L Series & Parallel
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Calculating Power Factor (PF) Using Impedance Concept — R-L Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive PF from impedance when phasors are not available, for RL series and parallel.
  • Why it matters: PF can be inferred from circuit parameters for quick estimation and design checks.
  • What you’ll learn: PF via $Z$: series PF = $R/|Z|$; parallel PF via $|Z|$ relation.

Key Points Summary

  • Methods to compute PF:
    • From phase angle $\theta$: $ PF = \cos\theta $
    • From powers: $ PF = P/S $
  • Using impedance when $\bar{V}$, $\bar{I}$ are unavailable.
  • RL series circuit:
    • $ |Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} $
    • $ PF = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}} $
  • RL parallel circuit:
    • From equivalent $|Z|$: $ PF = \frac{|Z|}{R} $
    • Using the provided relation: $ PF = \frac{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}{X_L} $
  • Series vs. parallel PF differ; see Part G for details.

Reference

  • YouTube: PF via Impedance – RL Series/Parallel

中文版

標題

使用阻抗觀念求功率因數（PF）— R-L 串聯與並聯電路

前言

  • 主題範圍：在無法直接取得相量時，利用阻抗推導 RL 串聯與並聯電路的 PF。
  • 為何重要：可由電路參數快速估算 PF，利於設計與評估。
  • 你將學到：由 $Z$ 出發的 PF 公式：串聯 $PF = R/|Z|$，並聯由 $|Z|$ 推得。

重點統整

  • PF 計算方式：
    • 由相位角 $\theta$：$ PF = \cos\theta $
    • 由功率比：$ PF = P/S $
  • 相量不可得時，改用阻抗求 PF。
  • R-L 串聯電路：
    • $ |Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} $
    • $ PF = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}} $
  • R-L 並聯電路：
    • 先求等效 $|Z|$，再得 $ PF = \frac{|Z|}{R} $
    • 依提供關係：$ PF = \frac{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}{X_L} $
  • 串聯與並聯之 PF 表達不同，詳見 Part G。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Apparent Power_PART A Apparent Power_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu
entry.content:
High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Apparent Power_PART A Apparent Power_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu

This article explains the concepts of apparent power, average power, and reactive power in AC circuits, including their formulas, physical meanings, and real-life analogies.

Key Points (English)

  • Apparent Power (S): The product of voltage $V$ and current $I$, representing the total power in the circuit. Unit: volt-ampere (VA).

  • Average Power (P): The real power consumed by a pure resistive load, analogous to rent—actual energy spent.

  • Reactive Power (Q): The power stored and released by inductive and capacitive loads, analogous to a deposit—eventually returned.

  • Meaning of Apparent Power:

    • At the source: Total power delivered to the load.
    • At the load: Rated capacity and rated current of electrical equipment.

  • Apparent Power Formula:

  • 視在功率的計算公式：

$$S = VI = I^2 Z = \frac{V^2}{Z}$$

或是利用功率三角形關係：

$$S = \sqrt{P^2 + Q^2}$$

單位為 伏安 (VA)。
Unit: volt-ampere (VA).

  • English Terms:
    • Apparent Power: 視在功率
    • Average Power (or Real Power): 平均功率
    • Reactive Power: 虛功率
  • Real-life Analogy:
    • Rent (Average Power): Actual expense.
    • Deposit (Reactive Power): Temporarily paid, eventually returned.
    • Apparent Power: The sum of rent and deposit, representing the total amount you need to prepare.

高中基本電學_交流電功率_視在功率_PART A 視在功率_陳政旭

本文說明交流電路中視在功率、平均功率與虛功率的定義、公式、物理意義與生活化比喻。

重點歸納（中文）

  • 視在功率 (Apparent Power)：電壓 $V$ 與電流 $I$ 的乘積，表示電路中電壓與電流的總功率，單位為伏安 (VA)。
  • 平均功率 (Average Power)：純電阻負載消耗的實際功率，類比為租房的租金，是實際花費的能量。
  • 虛功率 (Reactive Power)：電感與電容負載儲存並釋放能量的功率，類比為押金，最後會退還。
  • 視在功率的意義：
    • 電源端：表示電源輸送給負載的總功率。
    • 負載端：表示電力設備的額定容量與額定電流。
  • 視在功率的計算公式：

$$S = VI = I^2 Z = \frac{V^2}{Z}$$

或是利用功率三角形關係：

$$S = \sqrt{P^2 + Q^2}$$

單位為 伏安 (VA)。

  • 英文翻譯：
    • 視在功率：Apparent Power
    • 平均功率：Average Power (或 Real Power)
    • 虛功率：Reactive Power
  • 生活化比喻：
    • 租金（平均功率）是實際花費。
    • 押金（虛功率）是暫時繳納，最後會退還。
    • 視在功率是租金加押金的總和，代表你必須準備的總金額。

entry.title: High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Average Power_PART A Definition and Example of Average Power Calculation_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu
entry.content:
High School Basic Electricity_AC Power_Average Power_PART A Definition and Example of Average Power Calculation_Prof. Chen Cheng-Hsu

This article explains the definition of average power in AC circuits, the calculation formula, the effect of phase difference, and provides a detailed example.

Key Points

  • Definition of Average Power: The average power is the mean value of the instantaneous power $ p(t) $ over a complete cycle.
  • Voltage and Current Waveforms:
    • Voltage $ v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t) $ with phase angle set to 0° for simplicity.
    • Current $ i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t - \theta) $.
  • Instantaneous Power Formula:

$$p(t) = v(t) \times i(t) = VI \cos \theta - VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta)$$

  • Average Power Calculation:
    • $ VI \cos \theta $ is a constant, product of RMS values and cosine of phase angle.
    • $ VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta) $ is a symmetric sinusoid with zero average.
    • Therefore, average power $ P = VI \cos \theta $.
  • Effect of Phase Difference: If voltage and current have phase angles $ \theta_v $ and $ \theta_i $, then

$$P = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i)$$

  • Example Calculation:
    • Voltage: $ v(t) = 50\sqrt{2} \sin(377t + 30^\circ) $, RMS $ V = 50 $, phase angle $ \theta_v = 30^\circ $.
    • Current: $ i(t) = 5\sqrt{2} \sin(377t - 30^\circ) $, RMS $ I = 5 $, phase angle $ \theta_i = -30^\circ $.
    • Average power:

$$P = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i)$$

高中基本電學_交流電功率_平均功率_PART A 平均功率定義、範例：平均功率計算_陳政旭

本文說明交流電平均功率的定義、計算公式、相位差影響，並提供詳細範例。

重點歸納

  • 平均功率定義：平均功率是完整週期內瞬間功率 $ p(t) $ 的平均值。
  • 電壓與電流波形：
    • 電壓 $ v(t) = V_m \sin(\omega t) $，相位角設為0度方便說明。
    • 電流 $ i(t) = I_m \sin(\omega t - \theta) $。
  • 瞬間功率公式：

$$p(t) = v(t) \times i(t) = VI \cos \theta - VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta)$$

  • 平均功率計算：
    • $ VI \cos \theta $ 是常數，為有效值乘上相位角的餘弦。
    • $ VI \cos(2\omega t - \theta) $ 是正負對稱的正弦波，平均值為0。
    • 因此平均功率 $ P = VI \cos \theta $。
  • 相位差影響：若電壓與電流相位角分別為 $ \theta_v $ 與 $ \theta_i $，則

$$P = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i)$$

  • 範例計算：
    • 電壓：$ v(t) = 50\sqrt{2} \sin(377t + 30^\circ) $，有效值 $ V = 50 $，相位角 $ \theta_v = 30^\circ $。
    • 電流：$ i(t) = 5\sqrt{2} \sin(377t - 30^\circ) $，有效值 $ I = 5 $，相位角 $ \theta_i = -30^\circ $。
    • 平均功率：

$$P = 50 \times 5 \times \cos (30^\circ - (-30^\circ)) = 250 \times \cos 60^\circ = 125 \text {瓦}$$

entry.title: Example of Instantaneous Power in AC Circuits
entry.content:
Example of Instantaneous Power in AC Circuits

This article analyzes an example of instantaneous power calculation in AC circuits, including waveform equations, RMS values, frequency, and the physical meaning of negative instantaneous power.

Key Points

  • Instantaneous power $p(t)$ is the product of voltage $v(t)$ and current $i(t)$.
  • Voltage and current waveforms:

$$v(t) = 10\sqrt{2} \sin(314t) , V$$

$$i(t) = 2\sqrt{2} \sin(314t - 60^\circ) , A$$

  • Instantaneous power formula uses trigonometric product identities:

$$p(t) = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i) - VI \cos(\theta_v + \theta_i)$$

  • RMS values:
    • Voltage RMS $V = 10,V$
    • Current RMS $I = 2,A$
  • Frequency calculation:

$$\omega = 2\pi f_p = 628 \Rightarrow f_p = 100,Hz$$

  • Maximum and minimum instantaneous power:

$$P_{\max} = 30,W, \quad P_{\min} = -10,W$$

  • Negative instantaneous power means the load returns power to the source.

交流電功率瞬間功率範例解析

本文解析交流電路中瞬間功率的計算範例，包含波形方程式、有效值、頻率計算，以及負瞬間功率的物理意義。

重點歸納

  • 瞬間功率 $p(t)$ 計算為電壓 $v(t)$ 與電流 $i(t)$ 的乘積。
  • 電壓與電流波形分別為：

$$v (t) = 10\sqrt {2} \sin (314t) \quad \text {伏特}$$

$$i (t) = 2\sqrt {2} \sin (314t - 60^\circ) \quad \text {安培}$$

  • 瞬間功率公式利用三角函數乘積轉換：

$$p(t) = VI \cos(\theta_v - \theta_i) - VI \cos(\theta_v + \theta_i)$$

  • 有效值計算：
    • 電壓有效值 $V = 10,V$
    • 電流有效值 $I = 2,A$
  • 頻率計算：

$$\omega = 2\pi f_p = 628 \Rightarrow f_p = \frac{628}{2\pi} = 100,Hz$$

  • 瞬間功率最大值與最小值：

$$P_{\max} = 10 + 20 = 30,W$$

$$P_{\min} = 10 - 20 = -10,W$$

  • 負瞬間功率代表負載將功率回饋給電源。

entry.title: AC Power Reactive Power Part F Examples
entry.content:
AC Power Reactive Power Part F Examples

This article provides comprehensive examples of average power and reactive power calculations in various AC circuits, including pure capacitive, RL series, and parallel RC circuits.

Key Points Summary (English)

  • Example 1: Pure Capacitive Circuit

    • Voltage $ v(t) = 100\sqrt{2} \sin(500t) $
    • Capacitive Reactance $ X_C = 50 \Omega $
    • Reactive Power $ Q_C = \frac{V^2}{X_C} = \frac{100^2}{50} = 200 $ VAR

  • Example 2: RL Series Circuit

    • Voltage $ v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \sin(377t) $
    • Resistance $ R = 12 \Omega $, Inductive Reactance $ X_L = 16 \Omega $
    • Total Impedance $ Z = 12 + j16 = 20 \angle 53^\circ $
    • Current $ I = \frac{V}{Z} = 10 \angle -53^\circ $ A
    • Average Power $ P = I^2 R = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 $ W
    • Reactive Power $ Q = I^2 X_L = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 $ VAR

  • Example 3: Parallel Resistor and Capacitor Circuit

    • Voltage $ V = 40 \angle 0^\circ $ V
    • Resistance $ R = 20 \Omega $, Capacitive Reactance $ X_C = 80 \Omega $
    • Average Power $ P = \frac{V^2}{R} = \frac{40^2}{20} = 80 $ W
    • Reactive Power $ Q = \frac{V^2}{X_C} = \frac{40^2}{80} = 20 $ VAR

entry.title: Power Characteristics of Pure Capacitive AC Circuit
entry.content:
Power Characteristics of Pure Capacitive AC Circuit

This article summarizes the power characteristics of pure capacitive AC circuits, including phase difference, average power, reactive power, and waveform properties.

Key Points Summary (English)

  1. Voltage and current in a pure capacitive AC circuit have a phase difference of -90 degrees, with current leading voltage by 90 degrees.
  2. Average power is zero because positive and negative power waves cancel out; pure capacitors do not consume average power.
  3. Reactive power $Q_c$ formulas:
    • $Q_c = VI = I^2 X_c = \frac{V^2}{X_c}$
  4. Instantaneous maximum power $P_{max} = VI$ and minimum power $P_{min} = -VI$**.
  5. Power frequency is twice the source frequency.
  6. Power waveforms of pure inductors and capacitors differ by 180 degrees, being opposite in phase.
  7. When inductors and capacitors coexist in a circuit, their reactive powers subtract.

純電容交流電路之功率特性

本文整理純電容交流電路的功率特性，包括相位差、平均功率、虛功率與波形特性。

重點歸納（中文）

  1. 純電容交流電路的電壓與電流相位差為 -90度，電流超前電壓90度。
  2. 平均功率為零，因為正負功率波形相互抵銷，純電容不消耗平均功率。
  3. 虛功率 $Q_c$ 計算公式：
    • $Q_c = VI = I^2 X_c = \frac{V^2}{X_c}$
  4. 瞬間最大功率 $P_{max} = VI$，瞬間最小功率 $P_{min} = -VI$。
  5. 功率頻率為電源頻率的兩倍。
  6. 純電感與純電容功率波形相差180度，互為反向。
  7. 電路中同時有電感與電容時，虛功率做相減運算。

  • Why it matters: Connect time-domain signals to phasor-domain analysis for power calculations.
  • What you’ll learn: Convert cos to sin with a phase shift, identify load type, and compute power quantities.

Key Points

  • Given:
    • $ v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \cos(500t) $
    • $ i(t) = 20\sqrt{2} \sin(500t) $
  • Phase relation:
    • $ v(t) = 200\sqrt{2} \sin(500t + 90^\circ) $

    • Current phasor: $ 20 \angle 0^\circ $
    • $ \Delta\theta = 90^\circ $ → current lags 90° → pure inductive load.
  • Load type and value:
    • Pure inductive
    • $ X_L = V/I = 10,\Omega $
    • $ L = X_L/\omega = 10/500 = 20,\text{mH} $
  • PF: $ \cos 90^\circ = 0 $ → PF = 0 (lagging)
  • Apparent power: $ S = V I = 200 \times 20 = 4000 $ VA
  • Active power: $ P = VI\cos\theta = 0 $
  • Reactive power: $ Q = VI\sin\theta = 4000 $ var

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering – AC Power – PART B Example: PT, QT, ST, and PF (Circuit Diagram Type 1)

Introduction

  • Scope: Compute total active, reactive, and apparent power plus PF from a multi-branch circuit.
  • Why it matters: Aggregating branch P and Q correctly is essential to get the overall PF right.
  • What you’ll learn: Branch RMS currents, branch P/Q, totals PT/QT, and ST, PF derivation.

Key Points Summary

  • Problem type: Circuit diagram Type 1 → find PT, QT, ST, PF.
  • Currents:
    • Source RMS voltage = 200 V.
    • Each branch impedance = 20 Ω → $ I_1 = I_2 = I_3 = 10 $ A (RMS).
  • Total Active Power $P_T$:
    • $ P_1 = I_1^2 \times 20 = 10^2 \times 20 = 2000 $ W
    • $ P_2 = I_2^2 \times 16 = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 $ W
    • $ P_3 = I_3^2 \times 16 = 10^2 \times 16 = 1600 $ W
    • $ P_T = 2000 + 1600 + 1600 = 5200 $ W
  • Total Reactive Power $Q_T$:
    • Inductive: $ Q_L = I_2^2 \times 12 = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 $ var
    • Capacitive: $ Q_C = I_3^2 \times 12 = 10^2 \times 12 = 1200 $ var
    • $ Q_T = |Q_L - Q_C| = 0 $ var
  • Total Apparent Power $S_T$:
    • $ S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} = \sqrt{5200^2 + 0} = 5200 $ VA
  • Power Factor $PF$:
    • $ PF = P_T / S_T = 5200/5200 = 1 $

Reference

  • YouTube: PART B – Type 1 Example: PT/QT/ST/PF

entry.title: 高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率因數之改善_PART A 為何要改善功率因數？
entry.content:
English Version

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – Power Factor Improvement – PART A: Why Improve Power Factor?

Introduction

  • Scope: Explain the meaning of power factor (PF), the downsides of low PF, and benefits of improvement.
  • Why it matters: PF impacts losses, voltage regulation, and equipment sizing; utilities also price by PF.
  • What you’ll learn: Practical reasons and typical outcomes of PF correction in distribution systems.

Key Points Summary

  • Meaning of PF: PF = active power / apparent power; PF 71% → only 71% useful, 29% reactive.
  • Effects of low PF:
    • Higher input current → more copper, higher line losses ($I^2R$).
    • Larger voltage drop → degraded power quality.
    • Bigger capacity required for transformers/generators.
  • Benefits of improving PF:
    • Save electricity bills (penalized < 80%, discounts > 80% vary by utility).
    • Reduce input current, increasing line/transformer capacity.
    • Improve power quality; stabilize voltage.
    • Extend equipment lifespan.

Reference

  • YouTube: Power Factor Improvement – PART A

中文版

標題

高中基本電學_交流電功率_功率因數之改善_PART A 為何要改善功率因數？

前言

  • 主題範圍：說明功率因數（PF）的意義、低 PF 的不利影響，以及改善之效益。
  • 為何重要：PF 影響線路損失、電壓調節與設備容量，亦與電費計價相關。
  • 你將學到：配電系統進行 PF 改善的實務原因與常見成效。

重點統整

  • 功率因數意義：PF = 有效功率 / 視在功率；PF 71% → 有效利用 71%，29% 為虛功。
  • PF 低的影響：
    • 輸入電流提高 → 導線銅量增加、線路損失（$I^2R$）變大。
    • 線路壓降上升 → 供電品質變差。
    • 變壓器、發電設備所需容量提高。
  • 改善 PF 的好處：
    • 節省電費（多數電力公司 PF < 80% 加收費用；> 80% 依規有折扣）。
    • 降低輸入電流，提升線路與變壓器供電能力。
    • 改善供電品質、穩定電壓。
    • 延長電力設備壽命。

Title

High School Basic Electricity – AC Power – PART D Examples: PT, QT, ST and PF Block Diagram Problems (Two Examples)

Introduction

  • Scope: Use block diagrams to represent load powers, then compute total PT, QT, ST, and PF.
  • Why it matters: Block diagrams help visualize contributions of different loads and avoid sign mistakes in Q.
  • What you’ll learn: Summation strategies for PT/QT, relation to ST, and PF interpretation (leading vs. lagging).

Key Points Summary

  • Block Diagram Problem Type: Represent powers per load to streamline total calculations.
  • Total Active Power (PT): Sum of all loads’ active powers.
  • Total Reactive Power (QT): Absolute difference between inductive and capacitive reactive powers.
  • Total Apparent Power (ST): $ S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} $.
  • Power Factor (PF): $ PF = \frac{P_T}{S_T} $, label as leading or lagging.
  • Example 1: Compute PT, QT, ST, PF directly from given blocks.
  • Example 2: Infer missing values via PF–S relation before summing totals.

Reference

高中基本電學_交流電功率_PART D 範例：PT、QT、ST 及 PF 方塊圖題型（二範例）

前言

  • 主題範圍：用方塊圖呈現各負載功率，進而計算總 PT、QT、ST 與 PF。

  • 你將學到：PT/QT 加總策略、與 ST 之關係，以及 PF（超前/滯後）的判讀。

重點統整

  • 方塊圖題型介紹：以方塊圖表示負載功率，方便計算總功率。
  • 總平均功率 PT 計算：將各負載平均功率相加。
  • 總虛功率 QT 計算：電感虛功率減去電容虛功率的絕對值。
  • 總視在功率 ST 計算：$ S_T = \sqrt{P_T^2 + Q_T^2} $。
  • 功率因數 PF 計算：$ PF = \frac{P_T}{S_T} $，並判斷超前或滯後。
  • 範例一：依方塊圖數據直接計算 PT、QT、ST、PF。

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Basic Electrical Engineering – AC Power: Total Active Power (PT), Total Reactive Power (QT), Total Apparent Power (ST), and Power Factor (PF) Calculation Steps – PART A

Introduction

  • Scope: A structured procedure to compute PT, QT, ST, and PF, including multi-branch circuits.
  • Why it matters: Avoids phase mistakes by summing branch powers correctly before deriving system PF.

entry.title: Example Power Factor 10-6 Part C
entry.content:
English Version

Title

Example: Power Factor (10-6 Part C)

Introduction

  • Scope: Solve a PF example given voltage and current phasors; compute θ, PF, S, and P.
  • Why it matters: Reinforces the relationship among phasors, power factor, apparent and active power.
  • What you’ll learn: How to extract the phase angle, determine PF type (lagging/leading), and compute S and P.

Key Points Summary

  1. Hello students, welcome to the Basic Electricity MOOC by Teacher Chen Zhengxu.
  2. In this unit we introduce 10-6 Part C: an example of power factor.
  3. Given phasors: voltage $100\angle 30^\circ$, current $10\angle -30^\circ$.
  4. Q1: Find the phase angle $\theta$ between voltage and current.
  5. Q2: Find the power factor (PF).
  6. Q3: Find apparent power $S$.
  7. Q4: Find active power $P$.
  8. With 30° (V) and −30° (I), $\theta = 30^\circ - (−30^\circ) = 60^\circ$.
  9. 60° indicates current lags voltage by 60° (inductive).
  10. PF = $\cos 60^\circ = 0.5$, lagging.
  11. $ S = VI = 100 \times 10 = 1000 $ VA.
  12. $ P = S \times PF = 1000 \times 0.5 = 500 $ W.
  13. Alternatively, $ P = VI\cos\theta $ gives the same 500 W.
  14. Summary: How to obtain $\theta$, PF, $S$, and $P$ from given phasors.

Reference

  • YouTube: Example: Power Factor (10-6 Part C)

中文版

標題

範例功率因數（10-6 Part C）

前言

  • 主題範圍：在已知電壓、電流相量下，依序求相位角 $\theta$、PF、視在功率 S 與有功功率 P。
  • 為何重要：鞏固相量、功率因數、視在功率與平均功率的關聯。
  • 你將學到：如何從相量求出相位角、判定滯後/超前型 PF，並計算 S 與 P。

重點統整

  1. 各位同學好，歡迎收看磨課師基本電學（陳政旭老師）。
  2. 本單元介紹 10-6 Part C：範例功率因數。
  3. 已知相量：電壓 $100\angle 30^\circ$、電流 $10\angle -30^\circ$。
  4. 問題一：求電壓與電流的相位角 $\theta$。
  5. 問題二：功率因數（PF）。
  6. 問題三：視在功率 $S$。
  7. 問題四：有功功率 $P$。
  8. 由 30°（V）與 −30°（I）得 $\theta = 30^\circ - (−30^\circ) = 60^\circ$。
  9. 60° 表示電流滯後電壓 60°，為電感性電路。
  10. PF = $\cos 60^\circ = 0.5$，滯後型。
  11. $ S = VI = 100 \times 10 = 1000 $ 伏安。
  12. $ P = S \times PF = 1000 \times 0.5 = 500 $ 瓦。
  13. 亦可用 $ P = VI\cos\theta $ 計算，結果相同為 500 W。
  14. 小結：由既有相量求得 $\theta$、PF、$S$、$P$ 的流程。

entry.content:

Title

Example: Effect of Power Factor on AC Circuit Power

Introduction

  • Scope: Compare apparent power and current under different PF while keeping the same active power.
  • Why it matters: Lower PF increases current and losses; improving PF reduces capacity needs and cost.
  • What you’ll learn: Quick PF-to-current impact using $ S = P/PF $ and $ I = S/V $.

Key Points

  • Source voltage $ V = 100\angle 0^\circ $ V, active power $ P = 1200 $ W.
  • If $ PF = 0.5 $:
    • $ S = 1200/0.5 = 2400 $ VA
    • $ I = 2400/100 = 24 $ A
  • If $ PF = 1 $:
    • $ S = 1200/1 = 1200 $ VA
    • $ I = 1200/100 = 12 $ A
  • Low PF → higher current → more losses and capacity burden.
  • Improving PF → lower $S$ and $I$ → reduced losses and cost.

entry.content:
English Version

Title

Calculating Power Factor (PF) Using Impedance Concept — R-L Series and Parallel Circuits

Introduction

  • Scope: Derive PF from impedance when phasors are not directly available, for RL series and parallel.
  • Why it matters: PF can be inferred from circuit parameters, enabling quick estimation during design.
  • What you’ll learn: PF formulas via $Z$: series PF = $R/|Z|$; parallel PF via $|Z|$.

Key Points Summary

  • Methods to compute PF:
    • From phase angle $\theta$: $ PF = \cos\theta $
    • From powers: $ PF = P/S $
  • Using impedance when $\bar{V}$, $\bar{I}$ are unavailable.
  • RL series circuit:
    • $ |Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} $
    • $ PF = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}} $
  • RL parallel circuit:
    • Use equivalent $|Z|$ to get $ PF = \frac{|Z|}{R} $
    • With standard derivation, $ PF = \frac{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}{X_L} $ (per provided relation)
  • Series vs. parallel PF: different expressions; further details in Part G.

Reference

  • YouTube: PF via Impedance – RL Series/Parallel

中文版

標題

使用阻抗觀念求功率因數（PF）— R-L 串聯與並聯電路

前言

  • 主題範圍：在無法直接取得相量時，利用阻抗推導 RL 串聯與並聯電路的 PF。
  • 為何重要：可由電路參數快速估算 PF，利於設計與評估。
  • 你將學到：由 $Z$ 出發的 PF 公式：串聯 $PF = R/|Z|$，並聯由 $|Z|$ 推得。

重點統整

  • PF 計算方式：
    • 由相位角 $\theta$：$ PF = \cos\theta $
    • 由功率比：$ PF = P/S $
  • 相量不可得時，改用阻抗求 PF。
  • R-L 串聯電路：
    • $ |Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2} $
    • $ PF = \frac{R}{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}} $
  • R-L 並聯電路：
    • 先求等效 $|Z|$，再得 $ PF = \frac{|Z|}{R} $
    • 依提供關係：$ PF = \frac{\sqrt{R^2 + X_L^2}}{X_L} $
  • 串聯與並聯之 PF 表達不同，詳見 Part G。
